title: Nyerere National Park (Selous): Boat and Walking Safaris
excerpt: Nyerere National Park, created from the northern part of the Selous Game Reserve, is known for boat safaris on the Rufiji River and walking safaris.
body:
Nyerere National Park was established in 2019 from the northern part of the vast Selous Game Reserve. It is one of the largest protected areas in Africa.

## Water everywhere

The Rufiji River and a chain of lakes make Nyerere different from other parks. Hippos, crocodiles and water birds are everywhere, and elephants come to drink.

## Activities

- **Boat safaris** on the river or lakes. See [a boat safari on the Rufiji](/blog/boat-safari-nyerere/).
- **Walking safaris** with an armed ranger.
- **Game drives.**
- Fly camping in some camps.

## Wildlife

Lions, leopards, elephants, buffaloes, giraffes and good chances of [wild dogs](/blog/wild-dogs-tanzania/).

## Best time

The dry season from roughly June to October. Some camps close during the long rains.

## Getting there

A short flight from Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar, or a train journey. By road it is a long day.

## Combine

Nyerere is a popular combination with Zanzibar: bush and beach in one trip.

Read our [Nyerere page](/national-parks/nyerere-national-park/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
